results.title: Delhi wears the startups crown but Bengaluru still dons the unicorn hat
results.body: The Indian startup space is abuzz with deals irrespective of their location but founders from top colleges are on a fundraising spree. While Delhi boasts of the highest number of new startups, Bengaluru still dominates the funds by far, a Mint analysis shows.

results.title: Five Indian start-ups get funding from venture capital companies
results.body: Companies. IPO News. Start-ups.Bangalore: Early-stage start-up incubator GSF Accelerator is investing between $100,000 and $200,000 each in five Indian start-ups, along with other venture capital firms such as Silicon Valley-based 500 Startups.

results.title: Healthtech wearable startup Ultrahuman raises $17.5 million in funding
results.body: Bengaluru: Metabolic fitness startup, Ultrahuman, on Tuesday said it has raised $17.5 million as a part of its Series B funding from Alpha Wave Incubation (AWI), Steadview Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, Blume Ventures and Utsav Somani’s iSeed fund.

results.title: SaaS startup CustomerSuccessBox raises $1 million from pi Ventures...
results.body: pi Ventures closed its second fund worth $25 million in January. It largely focuses on early-stage startups working on AI, internet of things and currently has five portfolio companies namely CustomerSUccessBox, Zenatix, Ten3T, Sigtuple and Nirmani.

results.title: Delhi Beats Bengaluru In Start-up Funding, India Climbs To Third...
results.body: India’s startup ecosystem continued its strong growth in the first quarter of 2025, securing $2.5 billion in funding. This placed the country third globally, behind the US and the UK, according to Tracxn’s latest Geo Quarterly India Tech Report.
